title: Peacock Price Hike: Streamer Ups Cost of All Subscriptions - CNET
summary: The ad-supported Peacock Premium plan will now cost $13 per month, a $2 increase, while the mostly ad-free Peacock Premium Plus option is going from $17 to $20 a month.
